items.q: Is weed delivery legal in Virginia?

blocks.html: Under 2026 Virginia guidelines, adult sharing and possession of up to a legal limit is permitted for those 21+. Lifted Shop operates a gifting service in strict compliance with these regulations.

items.q: What is the fastest way to get delivery?

blocks.html: Calling (771) 216-1684 is the fastest way to get a live update on driver availability in your specific neighborhood.

items.q: Do you deliver to my specific neighborhood?

blocks.html: If you are in any of the cities listed above (from Aldie to Winchester), we have you covered. We deliver to private residential addresses throughout Northern and Western Virginia.
